movie_title: The Last Thing To Ever Happen In The Universe
introduction: Get 50% off your first month of KiwiCo at https://www.kiwico.com/kurzgesagt with code KURZGESAGT.
lead_intro: Have you ever wondered what will happen at the end of the universe? Let's explore the fascinating journey to the last thing that will ever happen!

quiz.question: What is the final step in creating the last interesting thing in the universe?
choices: Two carbon nuclei combine to become magnesium
Two oxygen nuclei combine to form silicon
Silicon nuclei fuse to form Nickel-56
quiz.answer: Silicon nuclei fuse to form Nickel-56
quiz.explanation: In the black dwarf, after eons pass, nuclei slowly combine, with silicon nuclei eventually fusing to form Nickel-56, which is radioactive and leads to the final event in the universe.

quiz.question: What happens when Nickel-56 decays into iron inside the black dwarf?
quiz.explanation: When Nickel-56 decays into iron, it emits two positrons which then annihilate electrons, reducing the pressure that holds up the black dwarf.

quiz.question: What triggers the uncontrolled collapse of a black dwarf into a supernova?
quiz.explanation: When a black dwarf loses too many electrons, it can no longer support its mass, leading to an uncontrolled collapse known as a supernova.

quiz.question: What causes the pressure that holds up a black dwarf?
quiz.explanation: Electrons in a black dwarf repel each other due to their density, creating pressure that counteracts gravity and holds up the star.

quiz.question: What process occurs when particles fuse together by jumping at each other?
quiz.explanation: Quantum tunneling is the process where particles fuse by jumping at each other, occurring even at temperatures near absolute zero inside black dwarfs.
